table.name: TLGNM_TRAILER_POSITION
table.description: Contains the latest known position of the trailers, and bizevent_id linking to the more detailed vlgnc_bizevent_map.

column.name: TRAILER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_trailer. The trailer related to this position.

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinates of the trailers at the time the event occurred.

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute coordinates of the trailers at the time the event occurred.

column.name: BIZEVENT_ID
column.description: Id of the bizevent related to this position (not yet FK). Used by Live map for a marker, where not only data from this table is displayed, but related data from vlgnc_bizevent_map also.

column.name: BIZEVENT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_bizevent_type_bs. Type code of the bizevent related to this position, needed for drawing different markers on the Live map start page. It is stored here directly, because such way we do not need to load the bizevent itself.

column.name: EVENT_TS
column.description: Creation Timestamp (Date and Time) of the event.
